lead: Mohammed Aziz was an Indian playback singer, born on 2 July 1954 in Kolkata.
He died on 27 November 2018 in Mumbai at the age of 64.
He has 6 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer.
This profile collects the Mohammed facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Mohammed Aziz — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Mohammed Aziz was born on 2 July 1954 in Kolkata, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name সৈয়দ মোহাম্মাদ আজিজ-উন-নবী at birth and is publicly known as Mohammed Aziz.
He is recorded as speaking Bangla and Hindi.
